parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum, slender and short compared to the minute hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour on the clock face by rotating slowly around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central pivot once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of aluminum, longer and thinner than the hour hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face by rotating around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central pivot once every 60 minutes.

parts.name: Clock Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the main surface or face of the clock, made of wood with engraved or attached numbers.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the base structure that holds the clock hands and displays the time markings.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the rotating hands.
